title: Drop the supervised loop and recommendation labels before they reach main
description:
## Goal
Keep Biblicus a feature and evidence engine. Learned decisions belong to Cyclotron.

## Work (after blbs-12b984)
- `topic_classifier.py` (2,051 lines on the curation branch): keep document vectors, keyword evidence and seed-topic projection as unsupervised signals. Remove the supervised, review-driven loop (training from reviewed seed items and steering feedback that behaves as a learned classifier).
- `steering_proposals.py`: remove the `recommendation` field (`recommend`, `do_not_recommend`, `needs_clarification`). Proposals stay proposals. Papyrus `AGENTS.md` already treats these as agent labels, not review actions, so no Papyrus review logic depends on them; confirm by grep before removing.
- Update features, docs and the Papyrus consumer notes in the same PR. Specs first.

## Decision context
Cyclotron (AnthusAI/Cyclotron) is one recurring yes/no decision with a batched decision model, an ML model fitted on human labels, an LLM optimizer, and a review program. Its own docs say its review-rate defaults are placeholders and no accuracy figure comes from real reviewers, so this removal must not happen until the shadow-mode task shows it works on Papyrus labels.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-19 correction to this issue's premise: Papyrus DOES depend on both things. (1) recommendation: src/papyrus_content/categories_steering.py:1015 sets reviewRecommended from proposal.recommendation == 'recommend' (shown in topic-steering-workspace.tsx and GraphQL); removing the field silently turns every proposal to reviewRecommended=false. (2) topic-classifier train and project are a live Papyrus workflow (corpora/papyrus-analysis-profiles.yml canonical-topic-classifier profile; topic-steering-workspace.tsx topic-classifier-train and topic-projection scopes). steering_feedback.py is a rejection-suppression input to proposal generation, not a learned classifier, so it stays. The relevance cyclotron decides reference relevance and Section placement, not topic assignment, so even a good blbs-67eb7d result would not replace topic-classifier. Removal needs a Papyrus migration first. Stays blocked on blbs-67eb7d.

comments.text: Blocked on blbs-67eb7d (in progress, owned by the Cyclotron session): Cyclotron runs in shadow on up to 300 pending p.apyr.us ai-ml-research References, and Ryan's accept/reject reviews supply the labels. Unblock when its report (accuracy, per-class precision/recall, Brier score, reliability bins, disagreements) supports promotion. Papyrus still depends on recommendation (categories_steering.py reviewRecommended) and on topic-classifier train/project, so removal needs a Papyrus migration first.
